# Asset Ledger

Every file under `assets/` (sprites, UI, fonts, audio) must have a row here, because it ships inside the desktop packages and the web build's `.data` file. The Kiroween 2026 rules prohibit third-party copyrighted or trademarked material unless we have permission.

**Allowed:** original work by the team, CC0, or SIL OFL (fonts only).
**Not allowed:** ripped or traced game sprites, game or vendor fonts, vendor logos, or copyrighted music.

"Original (project license)" means the file is covered by the repository's [MIT License](../LICENSE). Every original image is generated by a deterministic, standard-library-only Python script in `tools/`, so it can be regenerated and reviewed from source.

## Seed data in `data/seed/` (embedded in the binary)

Not art, but shipped content, so it is listed here too. All of it is **fictional sample data** written for AgentScape.

| Path | Generated by | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `agents.json` | `tools/gen_seed_codex.py` | 14 invented familiars (8 models, 6 tools) and invented vendors. Websites use the reserved `.example` domain. |
| `ratings.json` | `tools/gen_seed_codex.py` | Synthetic rating aggregates derived from a hash; no familiar is deliberately ranked above another. |
| `notes.json` | `tools/gen_seed_codex.py` | 49 generic Boons and Banes about AI assistants in general, attached to the fictional familiars. |
| `npcs.json` | hand-maintained | 8 fictional townsfolk, their sample Questing XP, looks and gear. Their names are reserved Adventurer names. |
| `quest_logs.json` | `tools/gen_seed_quest_logs.py` | 12 display-only sample Quest Logs by the townsfolk. Their ratings are already in `ratings.json`, so they are never counted twice. |

## Not in the build

`docs/screenshots/readme/` holds the README and Devpost screenshots (original, project license). They are not shipped. Every one is a real render of the app, made headlessly by `tools/render_readme_shots.sh` (plus the level-up frame from the `smoke_demo_path` test), so they can be regenerated after any UI change. Older per-PR captures were removed from the tree once they no longer matched the UI; they remain in git history.
